Committee on Contributions

Contributions received for 2026 for the United Nations Regular Budget 

As of 10 November 2026, 150 Member States have paid their regular budget assessments in full.
I. The following 55 Member States have paid their regular budget assessments in full within the 30 day due period specified in Financial Regulation 3.5 (by 8 February 2026).
